blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Commercial Fitout Cost in Southbank in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Wondering about office fitout costs in Southbank? We break down average prices, factors that affect your budget, and tips to save money without cutting corners.
body: If you're planning a commercial fitout in Southbank, the first question is usually cost. While every project is different, a typical office fitout in this area ranges from $800 to $1,500 per square metre. That covers basic finishes, new partitions, and standard mechanical and electrical work. High-end finishes or complex layouts can push that higher.

Several factors influence the final price. The age and condition of your building matter — older Southbank buildings may require additional fire safety upgrades or structural reinforcement. The scope of work is key: a full strip-out and rebuild costs more than a cosmetic refresh. Also, the quality of materials you choose, from carpet tiles to joinery, will drive the budget.

Don't forget hidden costs like permits and consultants. Southbank is within the City of Melbourne, which has specific planning requirements for commercial fitouts. You may need a building permit, plus fees for architects or engineers. At 8Projects, we include these in our fixed quote so there are no surprises.

Timing is another cost factor. If you need the fitout completed quickly, you may pay a premium for overtime labour or expedited material orders. Planning ahead — ideally 3-6 months before your lease start — gives you more flexibility and often lower costs.

To save money, consider a phased fitout. Do the essential works first and add nice-to-haves later. Use standard sized materials and off-the-shelf fixtures instead of custom ones. And always get at least three quotes from reputable builders who know Southbank.

The bottom line: a well-planned commercial fitout in Southbank is an investment that pays off. At 8Projects, we help you balance quality and budget. Call us for a free site measure and a transparent, fixed-price quote.

blogPosts.title: Retail Shop Fitout Guide for Melbourne's Southbank & CBD
blogPosts.excerpt: Opening a retail store in Southbank or Melbourne CBD? This guide covers permits, layouts, lighting, and fitout costs to help you create a space that drives sales.
body: A successful retail fitout starts with understanding your customer. In Southbank and Melbourne CBD, foot traffic is high but competition is fierce. Your shop layout needs to guide customers naturally through the space, highlight key products, and create a welcoming atmosphere. Our team at 8Projects has fitted out dozens of retail stores in this area.

Council approval is a must. The City of Melbourne requires a building permit for most retail fitouts, especially if you're changing the floor plan, adding mezzanines, or altering fire exits. We handle all the paperwork so you can focus on your business. Expect 4-8 weeks for permit approval, depending on complexity.

Lighting is critical in retail. Use a mix of ambient, task, and accent lighting to highlight merchandise. LED track lighting is popular in Southbank stores for its flexibility and energy efficiency. Also consider the colour temperature — warmer tones work well for boutiques, cooler tones for modern brands.

Materials matter. High-traffic retail floors need durable finishes like polished concrete or commercial-grade tiles. Walls should be robust to withstand daily wear. We recommend using modular display systems that can be reconfigured as your stock changes. This saves money long-term.

Budget realistically. A basic retail fitout in Southbank starts around $1,200 per square metre, but can go higher for premium finishes. Don't forget shopfront signage, which may need separate permits. Our fixed-price contracts include all costs from design to handover.
Ready to open your dream store? Contact 8Projects for a free consultation. We know Southbank's retail scene inside out and can help you create a space that stands out.

blogPosts.title: Bespoke Home Building in Southbank: What to Expect
blogPosts.excerpt: Building a custom home in Southbank? Learn about the process, costs, council approvals, and how to choose the right builder for your dream project.
body: Building a bespoke home in Southbank is an exciting journey, but it requires careful planning. Unlike volume builders, we take a personalised approach, sitting down with you to understand your lifestyle, budget, and must-haves. From the first sketch to the final handover, you're in control.

The first step is design. You can work with our in-house team or bring your own architect. We then conduct a feasibility study considering Southbank's zoning laws, site constraints, and your budget. This phase typically takes 4-8 weeks and results in a clear design brief and preliminary cost estimate.

Council approvals in Southbank fall under the City of Melbourne. If your property is in a heritage overlay or special character area, expect stricter rules on facade, height, and materials. We have strong relationships with council planners and can navigate the process smoothly. Allow 3-6 months for permits.

Construction time varies: a standard custom home takes 12-18 months from start to finish. Southbank's urban setting means we must manage logistics carefully — noise restrictions, traffic management, and waste removal are all part of the plan. Our project managers coordinate everything.

Costs for bespoke homes in Southbank typically start at $3,000 per square metre and can go higher for luxury finishes. Your biggest expenses are the slab, structure, and services. We provide a fixed-price contract so you never face unexpected costs.

Your home is a reflection of you. At 8Projects, we take pride in crafting spaces that are both beautiful and functional. Get in touch to discuss your vision — we'd love to build your Southbank dream home.

blogPosts.title: Office Renovation Tips for Melbourne CBD & Southbank Businesses
blogPosts.excerpt: Renovating your office in Melbourne's CBD or Southbank? Discover space planning hacks, cost-saving ideas, and how to minimise disruption during construction.
body: An office renovation can boost productivity and impress clients, but it's a big undertaking. In Southbank and Melbourne CBD, where many businesses operate in high-rise buildings, there are unique challenges. Our team at 8Projects has completed dozens of office renovations in the area and knows how to get it right.

Start with a clear brief. What do you want from your renovated space? More collaboration zones, private meeting rooms, or an open-plan layout? We'll work with you to design a floor plan that maximises natural light and fits your team's workflow. Good space planning can increase usable area by up to 20%.

Engage your building manager early. Many commercial towers have strict rules about after-hours work, lift access, and waste disposal. We coordinate with building management to minimise disruption and schedule noisy works during evenings or weekends if needed.

Budget for technology. Modern offices need robust data cabling, power points everywhere, and often video conferencing facilities. Don't overlook air conditioning — Southbank buildings often have central systems that may need zone adjustments. We include all MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) in our scope.

To minimise downtime, consider doing the renovation in stages. Fit out part of the floor while staff work in another area. We can also fast-track some elements like painting and flooring. Our fixed-price contracts include a detailed timeline so you know exactly when each phase starts and ends.
An office renovation is an investment in your team's future. Let 8Projects help you create a workspace that inspires. Call 03 9989 3888 for a free consultation.
